answer.origin: Finance.yahoo.com reported NN, Inc.'s announcement, published 2026-07-01. The reported announcement was made in late June 2026; the record does not give its exact date.
answer.note: NN said it would add 47 machine centers at its Wuxi, China plant for liquid-cooling production for NVIDIA AI data-center racks [incoming]. The report also says NN described 100% of the new capacity as already pre-sold under multi-year, multi-product awards [item:e2], and targeted US$80–US$90 million of accretive new business in 2026 from the expansion [item:e3]. For NVDA, this is a supplier-capacity and potential demand signal: it indicates NN is positioning production for NVIDIA-related racks and reports that the capacity is committed, which may support availability of relevant cooling products if the expansion is executed. It does not establish that NVIDIA is the direct customer, that the awards are all for NVIDIA programs, or that NVIDIA has placed orders of any particular value. The US$80–US$90 million is NN’s target for new business, not disclosed NVIDIA revenue or a confirmed result.
limitations: The report does not identify the award customers or disclose what share of the pre-sold capacity or 2026 business target relates to NVIDIA programs.
It does not state the expansion’s commissioning or shipment schedule, or provide evidence that the planned capacity has entered production.
No direct NVIDIA purchase commitment, order value, or contract terms are disclosed.
follow_up: Check NN’s announcement and subsequent company filings for the named award customers, the portion attributable to NVIDIA-related programs, and any disclosed order or contract values.
Check NN’s later updates and filings for installation, production, and shipment milestones for the 47 machine centers, and whether it reports achieving the 2026 new-business target.
Check NVIDIA disclosures or supplier-related commentary for confirmation of direct procurement or program-level demand linked to NN’s Wuxi expansion.
